rateLimited: Too many changes at once. Try again in a minute.
refused: The call's node didn't accept this
removeFromCallBody: They can't join again until you let them back in or the call ends.
removeFromCallInfo: This doesn't change the call's key, so they keep the current one. Remove them from the group to give the group a new key.
removeFromGroupBody: They leave the group and won't get its new messages.
removeFromGroupInfo: The group gets a new key, so they can't read its new messages or join its calls.
unsupported: This call's node can't moderate yet
